DTR · TALK ABOUT A SCENE

Letters You Can Hear

STS-MS6-L4-13001400-MSVPA-PPX-IMR-02 • MS Music Grades 6 to 8 • Performing with Technical Accuracy
Look at the picture. You will answer some questions about it. Press the play button to hear each question. Record your answer for each question. You can listen to your answer and record it again. Click SUBMIT RECORDINGS when you have answered all the questions.
JUST FOR FUN · OPTIONAL
Every month this class mails sound letters to a partner school an ocean away. Each one holds a song a student learned from a grandparent who carried it across a border, written down by hand so a stranger far away can play it exactly the way it was meant to sound. The class rule is short: send it as the composer wrote it, so nothing gets lost on the trip.
If you mailed one song to someone far away, what would you write on the page so they played it the way you hear it in your head?
Optional. You do not have to record this one.
1
Look at Yusra. What is Yusra doing?
Look at the picture. Justify what Yusra is doing with two pieces of evidence, then explain what she must get exactly right for the person who receives her work. Use exact words, not thing or it.
2
Look at Deniz. What is Deniz holding?
Look at the picture. Justify what Deniz is holding with two pieces of evidence, then explain what its printed label tells the person who gets it. Use exact nouns.
3
Look at the teacher. What is the teacher doing?
Look at the picture. Justify what the teacher is doing with two pieces of evidence, then explain why her step comes near the end of the work. Use exact verbs.
4
Where are these students? How do you know?
Look at the picture. Justify where these students are with three pieces of evidence, then explain how those clues fit together. Use exact nouns for each clue.
5
Tell me about the mail wall.
Look at the picture. Justify what the wall is used for with two pieces of evidence, then explain how its labels organize the work. Use exact words, not stuff.
6
Look at Marisol. What is Marisol wearing?
Look at the picture. Justify what Marisol is wearing with two pieces of evidence, then explain what her clothing and her task suggest about her role. Use exact color and clothing words.
Record an answer for each question, then submit.
Content alignment: MU:Pr6.1.6a — Perform with technical accuracy to convey the creator’s intent. ELD (Speaking — official ELPAC “Talk About a Scene”): PI.A.1, PII.B.3, PII.B.4, PII.B.5.
